svg.title: X6 - Molex STAK50H 28-position vertical header, Key 2 - mating face wireframe
svg.desc: Front (mating-face) view of the Molex STAK50H 28-position vertical header (2005011280SD) with the key lug in the Key 2 position, derived from the Key 1 drawing and the mating-cable key offsets (1600140012).
svg.text: X6 — Molex STAK50H 28-position vertical header · Key 2 (green)
Mating-face (front) view · A11 Radio (IOK) · header 2005011282 / 2005010282 (Key 2) · geometry from sheet 1 (Key 1 view); key lug relocated per the cable drawing 1600140012
Key 2 lug and wall channel, inferred position: centre 3.03 mm
below the mating-row centreline (Key 1 = 1.23; dashed = Keys
Square pocket at position 7 (cavity #7 void on the 28-way).
Mating-face numbering, pin 1 top-left; numeral right of its contact.
1-4 top row (4.00 pitch) · 5, 6, [7], 8 second row · 9-15, 16-22, 23-29 contact
Ring = occupied per the GM manual (pins 1-6, 8, 9, 10, 13).
Pin assignment — GM manual, A11 Radio X6 (IOK)
Harness: Instrument Panel Wiring Harness; OEM connector 35364137, service connector 13534971;
“29-Way F 0.5 NANO, 1.2 MCON, stAK50h Series (GY)”. Terminal types I (0.35) and II (0.75).
Header data — from the Molex drawing
STAK50H 28-position vertical header, series 200501 · SD 2005011280, rev D1
Housing SPS 30% GF · blades: copper alloy, Ni underplate, tin overplate

Source: Molex 2005011280SD sheet 1 (front view, Key 1) — the geometry is the manufacturer's own vector drawing, redrawn in black on white. The header drawing does not show Keys 2-4. X5 and X6 use the same STAK50H header.

Key 2 is inferred: the cable drawing 1600140011-14 gives the key notch offset below the mating-row centreline as (1.23) / (3.03) / (4.83) / (6.65) for Keys 1-4. The Key 1 lug on the header centres 1.26 mm below that

centreline (measured), so the lug was moved down by 3.03 − 1.23 = 1.80 mm for Key 2. Lug shape and wall channel are copied from Key 1; only the position is inferred, not Molex-dimensioned. Dashed rectangles mark the Key 1, 3

Contact centres were measured on the drawing (4.00 / 2.00 pitch agree with the Molex PCB layout, sheet 2). Key 2 per the design owner. Check: Molex lists Key 2 as green, but the GM manual describes the X6 connector as “(GY)”
gray, which is Molex's Key 3 colour — verify the key on the physical part. Interface drawing SD-160014-002 (bay/pocket definition) was not available.
